name: Ex-Wife Demon Hunter
source:
You works for the Bureau of Monster Registration and Surveillance. You next case: Three men murdered in an abandoned warehouse. The prime suspect: Your demonic ex-wife.  With your new human boyfriend in the mix, the investigation turns into a loyalty test. 

[From [url=https://mondlichtgames.itch.io/ex-wife-demon-hunter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你供职于怪物登记与监察局。手头接下的新案子：三名男子惨死于一座废弃仓库之中。头号嫌疑人：你的恶魔前妻。再加上你新交的人类男友也被卷入其中，这桩调查瞬间演变成了一场严峻的忠诚考验。

[摘自[url=https://mondlichtgames.itch.io/ex-wife-demon-hunter]itch.io[/url]]
